result.stdout:
npchelper 2.3.0 - tools for NPC Helper 2 content packs, translations and DLL mods

USAGE
  npchelper new pack <folder>                       Create a content pack with a starter NPC.
  npchelper new npc <packFolder> <NpcName>          Add an NPC to a pack.
  npchelper new translation <folder> --locale th --from <npcPackFolder>
                                                    Create a translation pack from an NPC's texts.
  npchelper new dll-mod <folder>                    Create a C# SMAPI mod project.
  npchelper validate <packFolder> [--base <npcPackFolder>] [--locale th] [--strict]
                                                    Check manifest, NPCs and translations.
  npchelper inspect <packFolder> [--npc Rei]        Show what the game will see.
  npchelper pack <packFolder> [-o file.zip]         Validate, then zip for upload (--force to pack despite name mistakes).
  npchelper release <release.json>                 Build several archives and NuGet packages from one manifest.

Run npchelper <command> --help for options. Packs and mods made with these tools need the NPC Helper 2 SMAPI mod installed.

result.stdout:
npchelper validate <packFolder> [--locale th] [--base <packFolder>] [--strict]

Checks a pack the way the game reads it: manifest.json, every NPC file, schedules, gift tastes, images and translations.
Prints every problem with its line number. Exit code 1 when there are errors (with --strict, also on warnings).

  --locale th        Load the NPC with that language applied.
  --base <folder>    For a translation-only pack: the pack that adds the NPC. Reports keys that do not exist there
                     and how much is still untranslated.
  --strict           Treat warnings as failures (useful in a build script).
